verdict.rationale: Asaas documents online card acceptance: credit and debit card charges via the API, processing card payments at creation or later, a hosted Asaas Checkout page, and payment links. A sandbox with fictitious cards lets a founder test the flow before switching to Production credentials. However, nothing in the evidence addresses how fast a new account is approved and can take live card payments, which is the core 'within a day of signing up' element. missing for 10: evidence of signup-to-live onboarding time or account approval/KYC turnaround, independent or hands-on corroboration of a first live card payment soon after signup.
